proposal.expected_benefit: This change will improve the robustness of the defense by ensuring that the system accounts for potential ambiguities in signal interpretation, thereby reducing the risk of misclassification and enhancing overall security posture.
proposal.problem: The defense response demonstrates confidence in the benign nature of the scenario but does not adequately address the potential for misinterpretation of benign signals, particularly in complex and indirect scenarios.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strategy to explicitly address the possibility of false positives and ambiguity in signal interpretation, even in scenarios that appear benign. This includes incorporating additional verification steps and refining confidence thresholds to better reflect the complexity and indirectness of the scenario.
proposal.title: Enhance Confidence in Signal Interpretation
verification_tests: Validate that the updated strategy addresses ambiguity in signal interpretation.
Confirm that confidence thresholds are adjusted to reflect scenario complexity.
